title: Desktop Side by Side Menu
description:
This is needed for Ambiendo MVP, as they are restructuring their category structure and navigation right now

---

🧑‍💻 **User Story**

**As** a user of an online shop on desktop,  
**I want** a clear and accessible navigation menu that slides in from the left,  
**so that** I can easily browse through categories and subcategories to find relevant products quickly.

---

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **General Behavior** The menu is opened via the main navigation in the header The menu **slides in from the left as an off-canvas panel** and displays the category corresponding to the clicked element  The rest of the page is overlaid with a semi-transparent background. The menu can be closed: by clicking a close ("X") icon at the top right of the menu, by clicking the overlay, or by pressing the Escape key. | Uses:  [desktop-menu-category-node-button](https://www.figma.com/design/L5EsT6m0VoOXsqqDHXtCe3/laioutr-SHOP?node-id=24-7307&t=6wm3tnzO3UwBzAin-4) [desktop-menu-list](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=18539-5274&t=36WdzhCBw9t12SQT-4) [text link with icon](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=4243-79657&t=36WdzhCBw9t12SQT-4) [desktop-menu-button](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=18532-65719&t=36WdzhCBw9t12SQT-4) |
| **Navigation Levels** **First level** displays main categories (e.g., Furniture, Decoration, Textiles and so on) and optionally addtional link list Clicking a category opens the **second level** with subcategories (e.g., "Textiles" → "Cussions" "Plaids" "Curtains" and so on). Clicking a subcategory opens the **third level** if there is one Each new level **slides in to the right**, [see simple example dummy](https://www.figma.com/proto/Zle03g3Z7ieN700SDq5j77/Component-Examples?page-id=1%3A143&node-id=10-48933&viewport=65%2C-19001%2C1&t=x8frY224lD6x49fe-1&scaling=min-zoom&content-scaling=fixed&starting-point-node-id=10%3A48933) (click on "Textilien" → "Kissen") When starting at second level A "Back" button at the top allows navigation to first level. Transitions are **smoothly animated** (e.g., 300ms slide-in animation). Mobile-like UX on desktop, inspired by mobile app menus. | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=c20148ab-5da5-413b-b80b-36d87e22aa45&&collection=&height=972&occurrenceKey=null&width=1444&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) User clicked on "Textiles" in the main naviagtion ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=26d719d0-5cb2-4f12-a532-d964e8951c58&&collection=&height=958&occurrenceKey=null&width=1443&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) User clicked on the "to all categories" link at the top |
| **Accessibility**  Fully navigable using the keyboard. Includes proper screen reader labels and ARIA roles. Focus trap enabled: focus remains within the menu while it is open. |  |

longDescription:
## Purpose

The Desktop Side by Side Menu provides desktop users with an intuitive, mobile-inspired navigation experience for browsing product categories. It presents a clear hierarchical structure that helps customers quickly locate products within complex category trees.

## Use Cases

- Browsing through main product categories from the header navigation
- Drilling down into subcategories with animated slide transitions
- Navigating back to parent levels using the back button
- Accessing category landing pages directly from menu items

## Design Rationale

The side-by-side sliding pattern brings the familiar mobile app navigation experience to desktop, providing a consistent mental model across devices. Smooth 300ms animations create a polished feel while maintaining performance. The off-canvas approach keeps the main content visible with an overlay, allowing users to maintain context. Focus trapping and keyboard navigation ensure full accessibility compliance.
